title: The lanterns on the counter
logline: Two days before the run: two lanterns on Gully's counter, wicks trimmed, a box of matches, the end stool empty. Six became two; the page counts the two before they're lit.

panels.composition: Two kerosene lanterns on a shop counter with their wicks trimmed and a box of matches between them, the end stool empty, the corkboard above.

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, two kerosene lanterns on a shop counter with a box of matches between them, an empty end stool and a crowded corkboard above, no people, no words legible

art.line: spare, knowing; economy of line; Era I's black spotting back on purpose in the mill run
art.palette: muted ochres, slate blues, misty sea-foam greens; luminous sunbreaks in the last spring
art.paper: Arches; bristol; the backs of motel registration cards
